text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how crushed I was by defeat,
I simply couldn't bring myself to give up.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because I have to show them.
As their older sister, I must show them a back they can be proud of."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you as well.
The run of one worthy of the 'Pinnacle'—!
